summary: Iteration 11 backend validation: router split (training + active_learning) regression, retrain nudge notifications, YOLO OBB export. All 15/15 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 2226 lines. Router split has begun (training.py, active_learning.py) but the majority of endpoints (images, teams, projects, notifications, exports, comments) remain in server.py. Continue splitting to keep files <700 lines.

routers/training.py uses `register(server_module)` pattern which works but couples the router to server.py's module namespace (s.db, s.get_current_user, s._project_access_check, s._log_activity, s.MIN_TRAINING_IMAGES, s.auto_scale_epochs, s._train_yolo_sync). Prefer moving shared helpers into a common /app/backend/deps.py or /app/backend/services module for cleaner separation and easier testing.

_maybe_send_retrain_nudge idempotency relies on `last_retrain_nudge_count` on the project doc. If a training completes between two approvals, the count query resets (uses reviewed_at > last_trained.created_at) but last_retrain_nudge_count is not reset. This could suppress a valid nudge after a completed training cycle. Consider clearing last_retrain_nudge_count on training completion.

YOLO OBB export writes corner coordinates clamped to [0,1] with max/min. For a 45°-rotated box that extends outside the image, this silently distorts the shape. Consider either raising a warning or preserving out-of-image geometry so downstream tools can decide.
Export endpoint: no explicit content-length header for streamed zip; fine for small datasets but could be problematic for large exports.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_iter11_* projects (nudge + obb) via API. Seeded 30 approved images directly in DB for nudge test + 2 approved images for OBB test (one with rotation=0.7854, one plain). Inserted 1 fake queued model doc. All cleaned up via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Router split verified working: routers/training.py serves /projects/{pid}/training-plan, /projects/{pid}/train-real, /models/{mid}, /models/{mid}/activate, /models/{mid}/cancel. routers/active_learning.py serves /projects/{pid}/active-learning-queue. All existing shapes/status codes preserved. Notifications endpoint returns {items: [...], unread: N} — not a bare list. Retrain nudge notification kind is 'training_ready' when project has never trained, 'retrain_nudge' otherwise; title contains 'X approved images'. YOLO OBB export writes 8-value corner labels only when annotation has non-zero `rotation` field; otherwise falls back to 5-value standard bbox.
